subject: Implementation blueprint & MAP — Brightline handoff and milestone owners
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@brightlinehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Implementation blueprint & MAP — Brightline handoff and milestone owners

Hi Lena —

Great speaking yesterday. As promised, attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that lays out milestones, tentative dates, and proposed owners so we can align on the go-forward plan and get CS looped in for the handoff. High-level timeline (proposed):

- Discovery / Requirements freeze — target window: Nov 30 – Dec 7 (owner: Brightline business lead)
- Sandbox provisioning & test ingress — Dec 8 – Dec 15 (owner: Redwood infra)
- Integration sprint (API + data flows) — Dec 16 – Jan 14 (owner: Brightline eng + Redwood integration lead)
- UAT & performance validation — Jan 17 – Jan 28 (owner: Brightline QA + Marissa)
- Go-live / cutover — Feb 1 (owner: Brightline + Redwood ops)

Attachments: Brightline_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP with milestone rows and RACI), SOW_Draft_Brightline.pdf (initial SOW draft for procurement).

Ask for you: 1) confirm primary Brightline stakeholders (technical and procurement), 2) confirm any hard constraints (blackout dates, procurement windows), and 3) whether you want a canary / phased rollout vs. a single cutover.

If this looks okay I’ll loop Marissa in to run the onboarding cadence and we can book a 30-min kickoff next week (I’m generally available Wed/Thu mornings PST).

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Brightline_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)]
[Attachment: SOW_Draft_Brightline.pdf (pdf)]

From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@brightlinehealth.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Rao <samir.rao@brightlinehealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@brightlinehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 12:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Implementation blueprint & MAP — Brightline handoff and milestone owners

Thanks, Dylan — appreciate the clear plan. A couple quick notes: 

- Stakeholders: Samir Rao (CTO) will own technical approvals, I’ll coordinate product/ops. Procurement looped for SOW review (procurement@brightlinehealth.com).
- Data/security: we need a short write-up on data residency and audit log retention for our compliance team. Can Marissa share the standard controls summary?
- Timing: procurement has an internal approval window the week of Dec 6 — if we can have an SOW by Dec 3 that would be ideal.
- Rollout: prefer phased canary starting with a 5% traffic slice for 2 weeks, then expand if no regressions.

I’m copying Samir and procurement.

On Mon, Nov 23, 2026 at 9:12 AM Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai> wrote:
> [See original MAP attachments]

Thanks,
Lena Ortiz
Director, Product Operations
Brightline Health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Implementation blueprint & MAP — Brightline handoff and milestone owners

All —

Thanks for the context, Dylan and Lena. I’ll take primary ownership of the onboarding program and run the mutual action cadence. Quick internal checklist and proposed owners (we should confirm during kickoff):

- Onboarding lead / weekly cadence: Marissa Cole (CS) — weekly MAP review sessions with Brightline (30–45m)
- Sandbox / infra request & access: Neha Kapoor (Platform Ops) — will own provision tickets and VPN/access steps
- Integration engineering contact: Samir (client) + Redwood integration engineer (assign after kickoff)
- Acceptance criteria & regression tests: Marissa + Brightline QA — we’ll codify in the MAP as part of UAT scope
- Canary rollout plan & monitoring: Redwood runtime + Brightline monitoring leads — propose an automated rollback policy at 10% error budget breach

I’ve updated the MAP in Drive (see link) with a RACI column and added acceptance criteria placeholders. Neha, can you confirm sandbox capacity and whether we need a dedicated GPU pool for their workload? If yes, we’ll need procurement notification for Dedicated capacity (lead time ~3 weeks).

Internal asks from this thread: 
- Dylan: get procurement contact to confirm SOW timelines (Lena asked for SOW by Dec 3).
- Neha: flag infra capacity and estimate any Dedicated capacity cost uplift.
- Me (Marissa): I’ll prepare a 30/60/90 onboarding checklist and a kickoff slide deck — aiming to share by EOD Wed.

I’ll draft a short security controls summary for Lena’s compliance team and include it with the SOW. 

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
[Drive link: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/BRIGHTLINE_MAP_DL-5273]

Hi Lena —

Per thread, attaching the SOW draft (SOW_Draft_Brightline.pdf) and the updated MAP spreadsheet with the RACI and acceptance criteria filled in (Brightline_MAP_v1.xlsx). Marissa will lead the kickoff and run the weekly MAP cadence. Suggested times for a 30-minute kickoff next week: Thu 11/26 10:00–10:30 PST or Fri 11/27 09:00–09:30 PST. Which works better for you and Samir?

Next steps summary: 
1) Brightline to confirm kickoff time and primary technical contact (Samir confirmed).
2) Procurement to review SOW and flag any redlines by Dec 3.
3) Neha to confirm sandbox capacity / Dedicated requirement by EOD Thu.
4) Marissa to send kickoff deck and 30/60/90 checklist by EOD Wed.

Thanks — looping Marissa to schedule the meeting once you confirm a time.

Best,
